episodes.title: Yoshi's Bar Mitzvah
episodes.summary: It's a night to remember when Avi brings his girlfriend home to meet the family on the same weekend his kid brother is becoming a man.

episodes.title: Hannah's Dance Recital
episodes.summary: Shira and Kendra head north to attend a winter-themed dance recital in Santa Rosa... and to ask Avi a very important question.

episodes.title: There's a Mattress in There
episodes.summary: With Elliott's blessing, Yoshi goes all-in on an exciting new business opportunity, inspired by a salesman wearing flip-flops.

episodes.title: Shira Can't Cook
episodes.summary: To crush the competition at a high-stakes school potluck, Shira tries making knishes — her mother's most difficult recipe.

episodes.title: Yoshi & Baby
episodes.summary: Yoshi's determined to come through for his sister and be responsible. But a chance meeting while waiting in line for potato ice cream changes everything.

episodes.title: Wolves
episodes.summary: While trying to address the "wolf situation" at Hannah's school, Avi teams up with a group of parents who take things a little too far.

episodes.title: Kendra's Job
episodes.summary: Kendra weighs the pros and cons of putting work before personal relationships when she's accepted into a management training program.

episodes.title: The Intervention
episodes.summary: The truth comes out when the kids come home for an awkward conversation under the guise of celebrating their parents' anniversary.

episodes.title: Honoring Naomi Schwartz
episodes.summary: A special event at the Jewish Community Center puts Naomi in the spotlight — but it's the same night as Shira's prom.

episodes.title: Uncle Barry
episodes.summary: A somber occasion brings everyone together in Las Vegas, leading to a surprise family gathering in the desert.
